word: A burned edge forms on the cooling tray.
answer: Un borde quemado aparece en la charola.

word: A thoughtful judge inspects the cracked crust.
answer: Un juez reflexivo inspecciona la corteza rota.

word: A compact loaf sits stubbornly in place.
answer: Un pan compacto permanece tercamente en su lugar.

word: A distracted assistant forgets the timer again.
answer: Un asistente distraído olvida el temporizador otra vez.

word: We are going to fix the undercooked center.
answer: Vamos a arreglar el centro crudo.

word: An airy layer collapses under slight pressure.

word: A motivated baker adjusts the oven settings.

word: An empty-headed comment irritates the contestants.

word: A focused competitor decorates the final layer.

word: A toasted crumb falls onto the counter.
answer: Una miga tostada cae sobre el mostrador.

word: We are going to encourage the unmotivated team.

word: A lazy participant leans against the fridge.
answer: Un participante flojo se recarga en el refri.

word: A deep-thinking chef studies the recipe carefully.
answer: Un chef profundo estudia la receta cuidadosamente.
